title: calea peduncularis var. longifolia
intro: Calea peduncularis var. longifolia, commonly known as Mexican Damiana, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the relief of symptoms associated with menopause, such as hot flashes and night sweats, as well as its ability to act as an aphrodisiac. The therapeutic actions of Calea peduncularis var. longifolia are attributed to its sedative, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to promote relaxation, reduce pain, and alleviate inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
